items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: And Jimmy Mundy was writing the arrangements. So I says, 'Yeah, I'll go on up here,' and I went on up there and went to work with Rush in the Savoy.

ctx.x: By this time, did Basie have arrangers, staff arrangers?

Yeah, yeah, he did. Of course, he would -- he'd listen to anybody's arrangement, you know, but Jimmy Mundy did a lot of writing for the band, and Andy Gibson -- I don't think Andy -- yeah, Andy did a lot of writing for the band and Buck used to do a lot.
